# name: # kind: physionet (zip from the get-zip endpoint, verified against the SHA256SUMS.txt inside) | zenodo (one file, md5 from the records API) | uci (zip, no published checksum) | ora (Oxford Research Archive file) | manual (data-use agreement; no automatic download)

note: Walch 2019: wrist accelerometer + PPG HR + PSG labels, 31 subjects (550 MB zip). Sleep staging, RHR window sensitivity.
Fantasia: 40 subjects (20 young, 20 elderly), 120 min supine ECG + respiration at 250 Hz with beat annotations (293 MB). RSA respiration, HRV sparsity.
MIT-BIH Polysomnographic: 16 subjects, ECG beats + respiration + R&K stages (632 MB). Respiration by stage, HRV by stage.
BIDMC: 53 x 8 min ICU PPG + ECG + impedance respiration with annotated breaths (208 MB).
Wrist PPG During Exercise: 8 subjects, wrist PPG + chest ECG with marked R peaks (50 MB).
GalaxyPPG: 24 adults, Galaxy Watch 5 PPG 25 Hz + E4 BVP + Polar H10 ECG with ms IBIs (482 MB).
Sleep deprivation HRV/PPG/PSG study (Zenodo 4326598): the R-R archive only (0.3 MB). PPG site unverified.
PPG-DaLiA: 15 subjects, E4 wrist BVP 64 Hz + chest ECG 700 Hz + respiration, daily activities (2.7 GB). No checksum is published; the script prints the sha256 it saw.
WESAD: 15 subjects, E4 wrist BVP + chest ECG, lab stress protocol. No checksum is published.
OxWalk: 100 Hz / 25 Hz wrist accelerometer with hand-annotated steps (290 MB).
DREAMT: wrist PPG + IBI + 1 Hz HR + PSG, 100 participants. Needs a PhysioNet account and the data-use agreement; download by hand into research-data/dreamt/.

Malaga treadmill maximal tests: 992 tests with breath-by-breath VO2 and HR (22 MB). Needs a PhysioNet account and the data-use agreement; download by hand into research-data/treadmill-exercise-cardioresp/.
